text: どちらでも　つかえるもの　などが　あります。

structure.jp: どちらでも　つかえるもの
structure.en: ones you can use in either

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a question word like 'which' gives 'no matter which'. どちらでも = 'in either one'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing つかう to つかえる turns 'use' into 'can use'. どちらでも つかえる = 'can be used in either'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. どちらでも つかえるもの = 'things you can use in either'.
